## Use Source Code Pro in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Source Code Pro for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Source Code Pro', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

## About the Source Code Pro coding font

From Adobe, a top choice for professional development environments. Source Code Pro is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Source Code Pro is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 15 CodeFont Top Picks.

## Source Code Pro FAQ

### Is Source Code Pro free?

Yes. Source Code Pro is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Source Code Pro support ligatures?

No. Source Code Pro has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Source Code Pro?

Source Code Pro is available from GitHub, Google Fonts and Adobe Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
